title: Settings
description:
Irori reaches your Tesla through Tesla's official API. You need your Tesla account and a website you control that can serve one file over HTTPS (any static host works). Tesla bills API use to your developer account against a monthly credit ($10 in the US), and Irori paces itself to stay inside an allowance you set.

1. Go to <https://developer.tesla.com>, sign in and create an app. Tesla may ask for billing details.

2. In the app, set Allowed Origin to your website, such as https://tesla.example.com, and Allowed Redirect URI to the same address followed by /irori/tesla. That page doesn't have to exist.

3. Give the app all of its access: vehicle information, location, commands and charging, and energy information and commands.

4. Copy the app's Client ID and Client Secret below, enter your website's domain, and save. Leave Private key blank: Irori makes one.

What happens next: open Devices, then + Add device, then Tesla. Irori lists what's left there, one step at a time: put a key on your website, sign in to Tesla, and approve the key on your car.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: The Client ID of your app on developer.tesla.com.

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: The Client Secret shown beside it.

commands_per_unit.title: Commands per 1
commands_per_unit.description: How many commands one unit of the currency buys.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency Tesla bills the account in, as Tesla's dashboard shows it.

data_per_unit.title: Data requests per 1
data_per_unit.description: How many requests for a car's data one unit of the currency buys, from Tesla's pricing.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description:
The website Tesla finds your public key on, without https://: the app's Allowed Origin,
e.g. tesla.example.com.

monthly_credit.title: Monthly credit
monthly_credit.description:
What Tesla takes off each month's bill. Tesla gives every account the same, in its
currency: $10 in the US.

private_key.title: Private key
private_key.description:
Leave blank and Irori makes a key, then shows you what to put on your website and how to
add it to the car. Only if this developer app already has a key: paste its private key
here, and the website and the car stay as they are.

redirect_uri.title: Redirect address
redirect_uri.description:
Where Tesla sends you after signing in. It has to be one of the app's Allowed Redirect
URIs; the page there doesn't have to exist. Blank: https://{domain}/irori/tesla.

wakes_per_unit.title: Wakes per 1
wakes_per_unit.description: How many wakes one unit of the currency buys.
